summary: A capacity refusal while rebuilding a reduced web candidate no longer persists a tentative PR ejection or failed-tree entry. The integrator retains the served build and retries the complete candidate on the next tick.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing capacity-refused retryable tick outcome; no wire or configuration changes.

downtime.detail: The previously served build remains active.

manual.detail: No new manual steps or configuration.

recovery.detail: Let host capacity recover and allow the next tick to retry. Rolling back this change can persist tentative failure/ejection state if a reduced-candidate rebuild is refused; no storage migration is required.
